Flow App

Run work on the move from one operating view.

Discuss a deployment↗See how it works ↓

LisBon Flow is the role-specific operating application for organisations using LFI. Managers, dispatchers, drivers and field operators see the work, ownership, current state, completion and exceptions relevant to them.

Who it is for

Transport and logistics businesses that need a connected booking and service experience for customers and drivers.

The system in action

See the work
change state.

01

The situation

Different people in a movement operation need different views of the same work, but still need one shared operating truth.

02

The system at work

Flow gives each authorised role the appropriate view while every action remains connected to the state held in LFI.

03

The outcome

A field update changes the manager view immediately because both roles work against the same operation.

Agree what success looks like

Make the improvement visible.

Work accepted; state updates; completion; exceptions resolved; status enquiries reduced.

Measures are agreed for each deployment. They are not guaranteed results.
